import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_frobenius (m n a b : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : m * a + n * b ≠ m * n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators

theorem study_d_frobenius (m n a b : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : m * a + n * b ≠ m * n
:= by
  intro contra
  have h1 : m * a + n * b = m * n := contra
  have h2 : m * a = m * n - n * b := by
    rw [h1]
  have h3 : m * (a - n) = 0 := by
    rw [h2, sub_add_cancel]
  have h4 : a - n = 0 := by
    rw [h3] at h3
    exact Nat.mul_left_inj.mpr ha
  have h5 : a = n := by
    rw [h4]
  have h6 : m * a + n * b = m * n → a = n ∧ b = 0 := by
    intro
    exact ⟨h5, hb⟩
  have h7 : ¬(a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0) := by
    exact h6 contra
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_d_frobenius = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_d_frobenius := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.study_d_frobenius
